name: lumen
description: Foundational compiler for the Lumen systems language

scripts.bootstrap:self: ./build/lumen-compiler compiler/main.lm build/lumen-compiler-self.ll && clang -Wno-override-module build/lumen-compiler-self.ll src/runtime/http.c -pthread -o build/lumen-compiler-self
scripts.bootstrap:all: npm run bootstrap && npm run bootstrap:self
scripts.run:basic: npm run compile:basic && npm run link:basic && ./build/basic; test $? -eq 3
scripts.run:control: npm run compile:control && npm run link:control && ./build/control-flow; test $? -eq 23
scripts.run:for-loop: npm run compile:for-loop && npm run link:for-loop && ./build/for-loop; test $? -eq 10
scripts.run:println: npm run compile:println && npm run link:println && ./build/println; test $? -eq 10
scripts.run:simple: npm run compile:simple && npm run link:simple && ./build/self-host-simple; test $? -eq 4
scripts.run:if-binary: npm run compile:if-binary && npm run link:if-binary && ./build/self-host-if-binary; test $? -eq 7
scripts.run:call: npm run compile:call && npm run link:call && ./build/self-host-call; test $? -eq 9
scripts.run:native-main: npm run compile:native-main && npm run link:native-main && ./build/native-main-self; test $? -eq 10
scripts.run:self:basic: npm run compile:self:basic && npm run link:self:basic && ./build/basic-self; test $? -eq 3
scripts.run:self:control: npm run compile:self:control && npm run link:self:control && ./build/control-flow-self; test $? -eq 23
scripts.run:self:for-loop: npm run compile:self:for-loop && npm run link:self:for-loop && ./build/for-loop-self; test $? -eq 10
scripts.run:self:println: npm run compile:self:println && npm run link:self:println && ./build/println-self; test $? -eq 10
scripts.run:self:simple: npm run compile:self:simple && npm run link:self:simple && ./build/self-host-simple-self; test $? -eq 4
scripts.run:self:if-binary: npm run compile:self:if-binary && npm run link:self:if-binary && ./build/self-host-if-binary-self; test $? -eq 7
scripts.run:self:call: npm run compile:self:call && npm run link:self:call && ./build/self-host-call-self; test $? -eq 9
scripts.run:self:native-main: npm run compile:self:native-main && npm run link:self:native-main && ./build/native-main-self2; test $? -eq 10
scripts.test:lumen: npm run bootstrap:all && npm run run:basic && npm run run:control && npm run run:for-loop && npm run run:println && npm run run:simple && npm run run:if-binary && npm run run:call && npm run run:native-main && npm run run:self:basic && npm run run:self:control && npm run run:self:for-loop && npm run run:self:println && npm run run:self:simple && npm run run:self:if-binary && npm run run:self:call && npm run run:self:native-main
scripts.test: npm run test:lumen && npm run stage0:test
